note: wm17e/wm17f/wm17g: Haliç Köprüsü decks for drive ways 86 + 3183 (the two OSM trunk carriageways named Haliç Köprüsü, bridge=yes). Deck crest ~22 m above the water [doğrulanmadı] (the figure is attributed to the 1974 KGM opening booklet "Haliç Köprüsü"; the booklet was not seen, only an unverified quote of it). Between the abutment road heights and the crest the profile is a smoothstep ramp over 250 m (yaklaşık [doğrulanmadı]). Strips 8 m. OSM (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
